rows.ARS: Mauve or mauve blend Large-Flowered Climber.
rows.Origin:
Bred by Interplant (Netherlands, before 2013).
Introduced in Japan by Keisei Rose Nurseries Inc. in 2013 as 'Amethyst Babylon'.
rows.Bloom: Lavender, dark red center. Mild fragrance. Average diameter 3.25". Semi-double (9-16 petals), in small clusters, cupped-to-flat bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Few or no prickles/thorns.

Height: 6¼' (190cm). Width: 7'7" (230cm).
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
